case_title: Plant reporter expression construct review case
design_goal: Document a traceable plant reporter expression construct case using the selected Registry components.

selected_components.selection_rationale: Used as the promoter slot because the Registry labels this record as a promoter and preserves a GenBank-derived boundary and source identity for review.
Used as the reporter CDS slot because the Registry labels this record as a reporter CDS and preserves the AF485783.1 feature provenance for review.
Used as the vector-source context because the Registry identifies a complete pBIN19 binary-vector source and records its T-DNA/backbone context; any T-DNA replacement remains a manual review item.

case_review_requirements: Confirm Registry identity, accession/version, sequence length, sequence hash, and source-record hash for every linked component.
Review the linked Knowledge Layer evidence objects and their claim-level provenance.
Review pBIN19 T-DNA and replacement boundaries before any future construct operation.
Keep all records in draft/pending-human-review status; this case does not certify function, performance, or experimental use.
known_limitations: The selected Knowledge Layer objects are DRAFT and PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW.
The promoter and reporter CDS have no independently reviewed literature citation in their linked objects.
The Knowledge Layer does not establish promoter strength, reporter activity, expression outcome, or host compatibility.
The pBIN19 record is a complete vector source with a recorded T-DNA replacement review requirement and rights caveat.
The Registry records these components as draft records and the current formal workflow cannot consume Knowledge Layer evidence as a native case input.
